a.lede: Ministers promise fresh procurement, but critics warn extension gives US supplier more time to dig in
a.title: MPs ask what the break clause was for as Palantir wins two more years in the NHS

b.lede: Despite calls from some Labour MPs to end the arrangement with Palantir, ministers say a new contract will not be awarded until 2029.
b.title: NHS data contract to stay with Palantir until 2029
